chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jaroud, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
"Therefore flee to Allah, surely I am a plain warner to you from Him."
He (peace be upon him) said: 'Perform Hajj to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic command 'flee to Allah' refer to according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) provides a specific exegetical interpretation (tafsir) of the Quranic command 'Therefore flee to Allah' (51:50), identifying the pilgrimage (Hajj) as the primary act of refuge. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly view that major rituals serve as tangible manifestations of spiritual retreat, linking the general concept of *firar* (fleeing/retreating) to the physical and spiritual discipline of Hajj.
